intro: New Life is a restorative Horde quest offered by Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat. Following the collection of enchanted seeds, the player journeys west into the ashen ruins of the Charred Vale to sow them into fertile earth. This ritual effort aims to spark the land's recovery amidst hostile elementals and harpies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you have seen, adventurer, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.
Friend, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!

clips.title: Progress
paras: These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.
Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. Will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.
Only then friend, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.
You have done well adventurer; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
